description: MaGIC Foglio 70 Porto Torres - Livello 2,3,4 (RNDT Dataset) - Versione 2.0 is a dataset listed in Italian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by GeoDati - RNDT. Rappresentazione della sola mappa georiferita relativa al foglio considerato, per i tre livelli di seguito descritti:Livello 2: Unità Morfologiche (UM)Rappresentano grandi unità all'interno delle quali si raggruppano tratti morfologici (EM del Livello 3) anche diversi ma la cui predominanza è caratterizzante e indicativa di determinati processi o fenomeni geologici.Livello 3: Elementi Morfobatimetrici (EM)Rappresentano elementi morfologici ... Coverage: GeoDati - RNDT. The portal files it under the publisher GeoDati - RNDT. Its tags are elementi-geografici-oceanografici, eu, hazard-area, mar-di-sardegna, marine-geology. The portal shows 2026-09-19 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support port and shipping studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-it-portal.
